top_fixes.rule: A request for a human: ask once whether you can help first. If they insist, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `general` and close as `transferred` / `human`.
top_fixes.why: If a customer in hardship asks for a human, the call can't transfer because that node has no transfer_to_agent tool and no route out. The case then fails on the missing tool call and on the transferred/human close.
top_fixes.fix: hardship node: add the transfer_to_agent tool with queue baked to "general". Add this line to the task_message: "If they ask for a human: the first time, ask whether you can help them yourself. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent with queue general." Add the transition transfer_to_agent_success_count greater_than 0 -> fin_transferred_human (outcome transferred, reason human). Check that every other conversation node after verification has the same tool and route.

top_fixes.rule: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as `transferred` with that transfer's reason.
top_fixes.why: After create_promise succeeds, the call goes straight to fin_promise. So if the customer then asks for a human or support, there is no transfer and the close is promise instead of transferred with that transfer's reason.
top_fixes.fix: negotiate/hardship: send the create_promise ok route to a new conversation node post_promise instead of fin_promise. post_promise task_message: "Confirm the promise (amount and date). If the customer asks for a human or support, call transfer_to_agent; otherwise thank them and say goodbye." Give it the transfer_to_agent tool. Its transitions: transfer_to_agent_success_count > 0 -> the fin_transferred_<reason> node that matches the queue (human -> fin_transferred_human, hardship -> fin_transferred_hardship), and matches_intent 'customer has nothing more / says goodbye' -> fin_promise. In the hardship node, make the support offer before calling create_promise.

top_fixes.rule: `close_call` is always the last tool call; nothing is accepted after it. `reason` is required for every outcome except `promise` and `paid`.
top_fixes.why: If the model calls close_call itself, or calls another tool after it, the case fails because of an extra tool call or an out-of-order call.
top_fixes.fix: system_prompt: add "Never call close_call yourself; it runs automatically when the call ends. Do not call any tool after the farewell." In the close_call pre_process_code, add a check that reason is set whenever outcome is not promise or paid (fallback reason from the fin_* node).

top_fixes.rule: Thank the customer and say goodbye before `close_call`.
top_fixes.why: The deceased farewell has no thank-you, which breaks the mandatory 'thank and say goodbye' closing in those cases.
top_fixes.fix: end_deceased terminal spoken_message: change to "I am sorry for your loss. Thank you for letting us know. Goodbye." Check that every other end_* spoken_message contains both a thank-you and a goodbye.
